DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この木は二人で担当してくれ。先に分担を決めよう。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You two will look after this tree. Let's decide how to divide the work first.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私が下の枝を担当します。相手の作業分まで自分の記録に入れないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共同作業の担当範囲と個別記録の希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll take the lower branches. I want to make sure I don't include my partner's work in my own record.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your share of the joint work and your wish to keep individual records. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: かごは別にする。途中で交代するときは、終えた範囲を伝えてくれ。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Use separate baskets. If you switch partway through, tell each other which areas you have finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別のかごに入れます。枝の区切りが分かりづらいところは、二人で確認してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 交代時の記録と曖昧な境界の確認を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll put mine in a separate basket. Where the boundary between branches is unclear, may we check it together?
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Discuss recording work when switching and checking unclear boundaries. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: よいよ。実を取る前に、どちらが担当するか決めておこう。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Decide who is responsible before picking the fruit.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この分かれ目を境にします。境目の実だけは、取る人を声に出して伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 枝の境界と声掛けで重複収穫を防ぐ案を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll use this fork as the boundary. For fruit right on the boundary, we'll say aloud who is going to pick it.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suggest using a branch boundary and speaking aloud to prevent duplicate harvesting. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 上の枝には手を伸ばさず、担当者に任せてくれ。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't reach for the upper branches. Leave those to the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 高い所は相手に伝えます。届かない実も収穫済みとは記録しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 届かない実を未処理として担当者へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my partner about the high areas. I won't record fruit I can't reach as already harvested either.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the person responsible about unreachable fruit as work still unfinished. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休憩前に、残っている枝とそれぞれのかごを確認しよう。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before our break, let's check the branches still remaining and each person's basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私のかごと下の未処理の枝を示します。交代後も同じ実を二度数えないよう引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩前のかごと残りの引継ぎを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show my basket and the unfinished lower branches. When handing over after we switch, I'll make sure the same fruit isn't counted twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain how you will hand over your basket and remaining work before the break. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分担と残りが分かれば交代できる。記録も分けて頼む。では、休憩後にまた会おう。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You can switch once everyone's share and the remaining work are clear. Keep the records separate too, please. I'll see you again after the break.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 靴の修理についてでしょうか。どこが気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about a shoe repair? What is troubling you?

DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 履いてきた靴の底が浮いています。預けるなら、帰りに履く靴も必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 履いている靴の傷みと帰宅用の靴の必要性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sole is coming away from the shoe I'm wearing. If I leave it here, I'll need shoes to wear home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the damage to the shoes you are wearing and your need for shoes to get home. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 修理できるかと仕上がりは、状態を見てからのご案内になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can tell you whether a repair is possible and when it will be ready after examining their condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日直るとは決めつけずに伺います。替えの靴を買う前に、預ける必要があるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 替えを買う前に修理の預かり条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll ask without assuming they can be fixed today. Before buying replacement shoes, I'd like to know whether I need to leave these here.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the conditions for leaving shoes for repair before buying a replacement. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 修理担当に見てもらいましょう。椅子で片方ずつ脱いでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's have the repair specialist look at them. Could you sit on the chair and take them off one at a time?

DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 座って脱ぎます。裸足で売場を歩かず、ここで確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 座って靴を脱ぎ確認を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll sit down to take them off. I'll wait here for the check rather than walking barefoot around the sales floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will sit down to remove your shoes and wait for the check. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当から、今日はお預かりする必要があるとの返事です。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The specialist says we need to keep them here today.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、帰り用を試したいです。修理する靴と同じサイズでも、履き心地を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 預かりの返答を受けて替えの試着を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: In that case, I'd like to try shoes to wear home. Even if they're the same size as the shoes being repaired, I'll check how they feel.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to try replacement shoes after being told your shoes need to stay for repair. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 試着後、購入を決めてから修理の受付を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: After you try them and decide to buy, we'll proceed with the repair intake.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらなら歩けそうです。この靴を購入して、古い靴は修理の案内を聞いてから預けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 替えの購入と修理受付の順序を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I think I can walk in these. I'll buy this pair, then leave my old shoes after hearing the repair information.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide the order of buying replacement shoes and arranging the repair. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 替えの靴を先に用意できますね。修理受付へおつなぎします。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: That way you can have your replacement shoes ready first. I'll put you in touch with the repair counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お盆をこちらで受け取れますが、お運びできそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You can collect your tray here. Will you be able to carry it?

DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 片手で杖を使っています。お盆を持つと歩きにくいので、席まで手伝っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 杖で手がふさがりお盆運搬の支援が必要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I use a cane with one hand. Holding a tray makes walking difficult, so could someone help me carry it to my seat?
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your cane occupies one hand and you need help carrying the tray. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 運ぶ係に確認します。お席はもうお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the staff who carry trays. Have you chosen your seat yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同行者が空いている席を探しています。通路に置いたまま席を探しに行くのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未確定の席と通路に置かない希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My companion is looking for an empty seat. I don't want to leave the tray in the aisle while going to look for a seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your seat is not yet settled and you do not want to leave the tray in the aisle. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お盆はこちらの台でお預かりします。同行者に席の位置を知らせてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll keep the tray on this counter. Could you ask your companion to let us know where the seat is?

DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 携帯で連絡します。窓側の席が取れたそうですが、どの席か指してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者に連絡して席の位置を確定させる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll contact them by mobile. They say they've found a window seat, but I'll ask them to point out which one.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Contact your companion and establish the exact location of the seat. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 席が確認できました。係がお運びしますので、お客様はお盆を持たずに移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We've located the seat. A staff member will carry the tray, so please go over without carrying it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 助かります。杖と自分の荷物だけ持って、その席へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理を持たず自分の荷物だけで移動すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: That helps a lot. I'll take just my cane and my own belongings and head to that seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you will move with only your own belongings, without carrying the food. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 料理の受取りを同行者へお願いしてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: May we ask your companion to receive the food?

DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、受け取ってもらいます。自分で運ぼうとする前に相談してよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者の料理受取りを了承して支援を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll have them receive it. I'm glad I asked before trying to carry it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to your companion receiving the food and confirm the assistance. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 料理は係からお席へお届けします。それでは、ごゆっくりお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: A staff member will bring your food to your seat. Please enjoy your meal at your leisure.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 提出先の案内はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have the instructions from the place where you need to submit the certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二か所の案内があります。証明書の名前は同じですが、必要な情報の説明が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同名の証明書に提出先別の情報条件があると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have instructions from two places. The certificate has the same name, but their explanations of the required information differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that certificates with the same name have different information requirements depending on where they are submitted. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらの提出先について先に確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which destination shall we check first?

DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず職場です。こちらは家族の情報が必要か分からないので、その部分を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 職場用の家族情報の要否を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My workplace first. I'm not sure whether this one needs my family's information, so I'd like to check that part.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to check whether family information is needed for your workplace. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行する内容は、申請前に案内と照合します。もう一方はどこへの提出ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll compare the contents to be issued with the instructions before you apply. Where is the other certificate to be submitted?

DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住宅の申込みです。職場用の内容をそのまま二枚頼まず、こちらも別に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住宅用を職場用の複製にせず別途照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's for a housing application. Rather than ordering two copies with the workplace contents, please check this one separately too.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the housing requirements to be checked separately instead of copying the workplace certificate. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内だけでは、住宅の提出先が求める範囲が明確ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: These instructions alone don't make it clear how much information the housing application office requires.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住宅の担当へ確認してから申請します。今日は二枚とも決める必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明な住宅側の条件を問い合わせて申請を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask the housing contact before applying. I don't need to decide on both copies today.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Postpone the application until you have asked about the unclear housing requirements. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 職場用も、不明な点があれば提出先へ確認してからお申し込みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: For the workplace certificate too, please check any unclear points with the recipient before applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 職場の案内で分かる部分を整理し、住宅の方は必要な項目を聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出先ごとに分かる部分と質問を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll organize what is clear from the workplace instructions and ask the housing contact again which items they need.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize what is known and what needs asking for each destination. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 提出先ごとに条件を確かめてお申し込みください。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please confirm each destination's requirements before applying. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは来院された方へのアンケートです。回答は任意です。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a questionnaire for people who have visited the clinic. Answering is optional.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会計の後に渡されたので、全部書かないと帰れない書類かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計後の用紙が全項目必須と考えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was handed to me after I paid, so I thought it was a form I had to complete fully before I could leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought every item on the form given after payment was compulsory. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会計は済んでいます。回答されない場合もお帰りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your payment is complete. You may leave even if you don't answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は帰れますね。ただ、伝えたい感想が一つあるので、その部分だけ書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 任意回答を理解し感想一項目だけを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I can leave today, then. But there's one comment I'd like to share, so I'd like to fill in just that section.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand answering is optional and want to give just one comment. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 答えられる項目だけでも結構です。個人の診療情報を詳しく書く必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's fine to answer only the items you can. You don't need to write detailed personal medical information.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 病名や検査結果は書かず、案内表示について感じたことを書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 診療情報を載せず案内表示の感想を書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't write my diagnosis or test results. I'll write what I thought about the directional signs.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will comment on the signs without including medical information. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この用紙には氏名の記入は求めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: This form does not ask you to enter your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で診察券の番号まで書き足す必要はありませんね。感想の文章だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不要な氏名や診察券番号を自分で追加しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I don't need to add my patient card number myself either. I'll write only my comment.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you will not add an unnecessary name or patient card number yourself. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入後は、受付横の回収箱へ入れていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you've finished, you can put it in the collection box beside reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一つの項目を記入しました。ほかは空欄で提出し、会計の書類は持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 空欄を残して提出し会計書類は別に持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've filled in one item. I'll submit it with the others blank and take the payment documents home separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit the form with blanks remaining and take the payment documents home separately. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご意見をお寄せいただきありがとうございます。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for sharing your opinion. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計へどうぞ。こちらのお品はまとめてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please come to the checkout. May I ring these items up together?

DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜勤の仲間に頼まれた物と自分の物があります。支払う前に二つに分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共同購入と私用の品を支払い前に別会計で頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are things my night-shift colleagues asked me to buy and things for myself. I'd like to split them into two purchases before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for separate payments for the shared purchase and personal items before paying. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先にお会計する方のお品を、こちらへまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please gather the items you want to pay for first over here.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仲間の飲物はこちらです。私のお菓子は残して、混ぜずに置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先に精算する共同購入品を明確に分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here are my colleagues' drinks. I'll leave my snacks separate without mixing them in.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clearly separate the shared items to be paid for first. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一つ目のお会計が終わりました。レシートをどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The first payment is complete. Here is your receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これは共同購入の記録に使います。財布へ入れる前に、飲物だけ載っているか見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一枚目のレシートの品目と用途を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use this as a record of the shared purchase. Before putting it in my wallet, I'll check that it lists only the drinks.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the items on the first receipt and explain its purpose. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つ目はお菓子ですね。袋も別にされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The second purchase is the snacks, correct? Would you like separate bags too?

DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋は一つでよいです。職場で渡すときに、レシートだけ取り違えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋は共用し控えだけを区別すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: One bag is fine. When I hand them over at work, I'll make sure I don't mix up the receipts.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you will share one bag but keep the receipts distinct. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが二つ目のレシートです。お品物もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's your second receipt. Please check your items too.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 飲物とお菓子を受け取りました。二枚のレシートは別のポケットへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全品と二枚の控えの受取りを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the drinks and snacks. I'll put the two receipts in separate pockets.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you have received all the items and both receipts. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 別会計のお品と控えがそろいました。夜道にお気をつけて。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You now have the separately paid items and their receipts. Take care on your way home tonight. Please visit us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 窓口の確認を始めてよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: May we begin the checks at the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族から電話が来ました。口座番号を聞かれていますが、ここで声に出すのは控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待合で電話相手へ口座番号を読み上げないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family has called. They're asking for my account number, but I'll avoid reading it aloud here.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you will not read your account number aloud to the caller in the waiting area. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お電話が終わってから、ご本人の用件を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll hear your own request once you've finished the call.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 急ぎか確認しました。後で連絡すればよいそうなので、いったん電話を切ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話の緊急性を確認して後の連絡へ切り替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I checked whether it was urgent. They say I can contact them later, so I'll end the call for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check how urgent the call is and switch to contacting them later. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。本日のご用件をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. Please tell us what you need today.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 給与の入金を確認したいです。家族の用件とは別で、私の口座についてです。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族の質問と自分の給与入金確認を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to check whether my salary has been deposited. This is about my account, separate from my family's question.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate your family's question from your own salary deposit inquiry. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認に必要な物は窓口で拝見します。番号を周囲へ聞こえるように読む必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll look at the necessary items at the counter. You don't need to read the number loudly enough for people around you to hear.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通帳をお見せします。電話の相手にも、ここで確認した内容をそのまま読み上げません。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口に通帳を示し取引内容を電話へ読み上げないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll show you my bankbook. I won't read out everything confirmed here to the person on the phone either.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reply that you will show your bankbook at the counter and not read transaction details over the phone. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人様の確認を終えてから、取引の案内を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll proceed with the transaction guidance after verifying your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 窓口の確認に集中します。家族には、必要なことを後で自分から連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人確認に集中し家族へ後で連絡すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll focus on the checks at the counter. I'll contact my family myself later with what they need to know.
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to focus on identity verification and contact your family later. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お電話と窓口の用件を分けられましたね。担当から取引をご案内します。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-019-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've separated the phone call from your business at the counter. The staff member will guide you through the transaction. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの改札をご利用ですか。お連れの方も乗られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you using this ticket gate? Is the person with you travelling too?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗るのは私だけです。父が見送りに来てくれたのですが、話が終わらず、そろそろホームへ行くべきか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人だけが乗車し父との見送りの話を切り上げる時機を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only I'm travelling. My father came to see me off, but we haven't finished talking, and I'm wondering whether I should head to the platform soon.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only you are travelling and ask when to finish talking with your father seeing you off. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お乗りになる列車の時刻を確認しましょう。お父様は、ここでお見送りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check your train's departure time. Your father is seeing you off here, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。切符の時刻はこちらです。父はまだ旅行の注意をいくつか話したいようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符の発車時刻を示し父がまだ伝えたい注意があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Here is the time on my ticket. My father still seems to have a few travel precautions he wants to tell me.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the departure time on your ticket and explain that your father still has advice to share. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発車まであまり余裕がありません。今のお話を短くまとめ、残りは後で連絡されてはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: There isn't much time before departure. How about briefly wrapping up the current conversation and contacting each other later about the rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父に、乗って落ち着いたら連絡すると伝えます。今ここで全部聞き終えようとせず、挨拶をして出発したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗車後に連絡すると父へ伝えその場の話を短く終えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell my father I'll contact him once I've boarded and settled down. Rather than trying to hear everything here, I'd like to say goodbye and leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to tell your father you will contact him after boarding and bring the conversation to a brief close. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お話しになる間は、改札の通り道を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the passage through the ticket gates clear while you talk.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 脇へ移りました。父にもここで待ってもらい、私が乗る列へ一緒に並んでもらうのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路の脇へ移り見送りの父は改札前に残ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: We've moved to the side. I'll ask my father to wait here rather than join the line with me for boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have moved beside the passage and your father will remain before the ticket gates to see you off. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 挨拶がお済みでしたら、行先の表示を確認してホームへお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've said goodbye, check the destination sign and proceed to the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 父に次に帰る予定も話せました。荷物と切符を持って、これから自分の列車へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 父へ再会予定を話し本人の荷物と切符で乗車へ向かうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I was also able to tell my father when I plan to return next. I'll take my luggage and ticket and head for my train now.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have told your father when you plan to meet again and are heading to board with your own luggage and ticket. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、安心してお見送りいただけますね。それでは、よいご旅行を。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then he can see you off with peace of mind. Have a good trip, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票のこの欄で、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with this section of the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「食欲」という言葉がよく分かりません。今朝は食べたので、ありと書けばいいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食欲という問診語の意味が分からず今朝食べた事実で回答してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't really understand the word 'appetite.' I ate this morning, so should I mark that I have one?
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what the questionnaire term 'appetite' means and whether you can answer based on having eaten this morning. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食べたいと感じるかどうかについての言葉です。最近の食事の様子で、気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: It refers to whether you feel like eating. Is there anything about your recent eating habits that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝は少し食べましたが、食べたい気持ちはあまりありません。仕事へ行くため、何か食べようと思ったんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 少し食べたが食べたい気持ちは弱かったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I ate a little this morning, but I don't feel much like eating. I thought I should eat something because I was going to work.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you ate a little but had little desire to eat. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食べた量と、ご自身の感じ方を担当へお伝えください。受付だけで状態の判断はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the clinician both how much you ate and how you feel. Reception alone cannot assess your condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 食べているから普段どおりとは答えず、あまり食べたくないことも書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食べた事実だけで普段どおりとはせず自分の感じ方も記載したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than saying I'm as usual just because I've eaten, I'd like to write that I don't feel much like eating too.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to record how you feel rather than describing things as usual solely because you have eaten. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いつ頃からそう感じていますか。分かる範囲でお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: When did you start feeling that way? Please tell us as much as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一昨日の夕方からです。昨日も夕食はいつもの半分くらいでした。正確な量は量っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一昨日夕方からの変化と昨日夕食の概量を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Since the evening before yesterday. Yesterday I also ate about half my usual dinner. I didn't measure the exact amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the change since the evening before yesterday and the approximate amount of yesterday's dinner. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その説明を添えて、担当にご相談ください。書き方で迷う部分は、空けたまま質問できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please include that explanation when you speak to the clinician. You can leave sections you're unsure how to fill in blank and ask about them.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 食べたい気持ちが弱いことと、少量は食べていることを分けて書きます。分からないところは診察で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食事量と食べたい気持ちを書き分け未理解の点は診療担当へ尋ねると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write separately that my desire to eat is low and that I am eating small amounts. I'll clarify anything I don't understand during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to distinguish food intake from the desire to eat in writing and ask the clinician about anything unclear. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、そのメモも一緒にお持ちください。それでは、診察のご案内までお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring that note with you too. Now please wait until we call you for your consultation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 香りのある野菜をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for aromatic vegetables?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母国でよく食べた料理を作りたいです。この売場で、香りを加える野菜を選ぶ手伝いをお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母国の料理へ香りを加える野菜探しを手伝ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to make a dish I often ate in my home country. Could you help me choose vegetables here that will add fragrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help finding vegetables to add fragrance to a dish from your home country. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お料理の名前より、どのような香りがお好みか教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than the name of the dish, could you tell me what kind of fragrance you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: すっきりした香りが好きです。ただ、家族は強い香りの野菜を食べ慣れていないので、大袋を買うか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 好きな香りと家族が強い香りに不慣れなことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I like a fresh, clean fragrance. But my family isn't used to strongly scented vegetables, so I'm unsure whether to buy a large bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your preferred fragrance and that your family is not used to strongly scented vegetables. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 少量のものから試してみる方法もあります。こちらの小さい束をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You could start by trying a small amount. Would you like to look at this small bunch?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見たいです。これで母国の味がそのまま作れると期待しすぎず、まず自分で少し試してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小さい束を見て母国の味の完全再現を期待せず試すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I'd like to. Without expecting too much that it will reproduce the exact taste from home, I'll first try a little myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Look at a small bunch and say you will try it without expecting to recreate your home country's taste exactly. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使う量は、ご自身の料理に合わせてお考えください。保存の表示もこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please decide how much to use according to your own cooking. The storage instructions are here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示を確認しました。家族の分へ全部混ぜず、食べる時に好きな人だけ足せるよう別に置きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保存表示を確認し家族の料理には別添えにすると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've checked the instructions. Rather than mixing it all into my family's food, I'd like to serve it separately so only those who want it can add it while eating.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the storage label and decide to serve it separately from your family's food. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小さい束を一つでよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like one small bunch?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一つお願いします。家族の感想を聞いてから、次にどのくらい使うか考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一束を選び家族の感想から次回の使用量を考えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: One, please. After hearing what my family thinks, I'll decide how much to use next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose one bunch and say you will consider how much to use next time based on your family's feedback. Please speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの一束ですね。それでは、ご家族とのお料理の時間をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: One bunch of this, then. Enjoy your time cooking with your family.
